title: HandXFM: Semantic-Structural Distillation for Hand Radiograph Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hand radiographs support diverse clinical tasks, including skeletal maturity assessment, rheumatoid arthritis scoring, abnormality screening, and anatomical localization, yet existing models are typically trained separately for each task and dataset. We present HandXFM, a domain-specific foundation model that leverages cross-modality knowledge for comprehensive hand X-ray understanding. HandXFM distills semantic priors from BiomedCLIP and structural cues from a chest X-ray Vision Transformer (ViT) through a unified alignment framework, integrating complementary medical knowledge in an interpretable way. After pretraining, HandXFM can be adapted to a range of musculoskeletal tasks, including bone age estimation, SvH score prediction, abnormality detection, joint localization, bone segmentation, and visual question answering. It consistently outperforms task-specific and single-expert baselines, achieving up to 0.11 improvement in Pearso

translated_title: HandXFM：面向手部X光片基础模型的语义-结构蒸馏
translated_abstract: 手部X光片支持多种多样的临床任务，包括骨骼成熟度评估、类风湿关节炎评分、异常筛查和解剖定位，然而现有模型通常针对每个任务和数据集分别训练。我们提出了HandXFM，这是一个领域专用的基础模型，利用跨模态知识实现全面的手部X光理解。HandXFM通过统一的对齐框架，从BiomedCLIP中蒸馏语义先验，并从胸部X光视觉Transformer（ViT）中蒸馏结构线索，以可解释的方式整合互补的医学知识。在预训练之后，HandXFM可以适配到一系列肌肉骨骼任务中，包括骨龄估计、SvH评分预测、异常检测、关节定位、骨骼分割和视觉问答。它在这些任务上持续优于任务专用模型和单专家基线，在皮尔逊相关系数上取得了高达0.11的提升。
tldr: HandXFM是一个手部X光片基础模型，通过统一对齐框架从BiomedCLIP蒸馏语义先验、从胸部X光ViT蒸馏结构线索，能够适配骨龄估计、异常检测、分割与视觉问答等多种肌肉骨骼任务并超越任务专用基线。
